name: Sean Vadney

summary.text: Sean Vadney is a small business owner and political volunteer who is the Libertarian nominee for Colorado Secretary of State.
He was selected to replace Alex Astley as the Libertarian Party's general-election candidate after finishing second to Astley, 61.9% to 38.1%, in the June 30, 2026 Libertarian primary.

experience.text: Small business owner; has been involved in Colorado politics for about seven years as a volunteer.
Lives in Highlands Ranch; the Denver Post's candidate Q&A lists his profession as entertainment and hospitality and his education as Southern New Hampshire University.

positions.source_title: Secretary of State | Gonzalez, Wiley are top contenders for open seat
positions.quote: I would roll back the mail-in voting system with exceptions for individuals who have disabilities that make in-person voting difficult.
positions.note: He carves out a disability exception, but frames rolling back universal mail voting as a central campaign position: "There's no reason why in-person voting shouldn't be the primary method our state uses."

positions.quote: This includes requiring government-issued identification when voting, verifying citizenship during voter registration, maintaining accurate voter rolls
positions.note: General support for voter identification without mention of mail ballots, which the coding rule treats as inferred and capped at agree. Vote411 shows answers only after an address is entered, so the quote cannot be checked by script; it was read in a browser on 2026-10-15 using a public address in the race.
